turns.assessment: The outage is a hard bidirectional optical break on the S18–S19 route. Simultaneous AMP_INPUT_LOS at the central inline amplifier in both directions localizes it to the same physical cable segment, while unchanged pump currents argue strongly against amplifier pump failure. This explains loss of the S21–S03 lightpath used by svc109; its S03–S02 lightpath remained optically normal. The exact fibre-span element has no identifier in the brief, so a repairable named element cannot be committed.

proposals.rationale: O1 and O2 are simultaneous input-LOS alarms in opposite directions at corresponding central amplifiers, the characteristic signature of both fibres of the intervening cable being cut. The widespread all-channel losses and unchanged amplifier pump currents further support a span break rather than equipment failure.
